prompts.sponge: Use case: precise-object-edit / background-extraction, faithful original Flash game sprite restoration. Four reference images: image1 ORIGINAL spoiled food hover balloon; image2 ORIGINAL two-row menu saying Comprar tempero / Jogar fora; image3 ORIGINAL bottom toolbar mortar; image4 CURRENT IMPLEMENTATION with bad geometric sponge and oversized white rows. Edit target ONLY the small cleaning sponge at lower left of image2 ORIGINAL menu. Ignore the sponge in image4 entirely. Extract and restore ONE original cleaning sponge icon as a production PNG with genuine transparent RGBA background. Exactly match original: a small compact slightly rounded rectangular yellow/orange sponge base with dark forest green scrub layer on top, seen from a mild isometric 2:1 angle. Top layer upper face green #237447, front side warm bright yellow #ffd33b and side golden amber #e6a918, subtle hand-drawn dark brown/green contour. Edges naturally softly rounded and slightly uneven like original Flash painted illustration, not rigid polygon block. THREE small translucent light cyan/white soap bubbles rising above sponge, arranged loosely vertically and offset, each thin cyan edge and tiny white reflective crescent. Original proportions: sponge body about 44 wide by 33 high, bubbles extend ~25px above it, entire sprite about 48x61 at original display size. Preserve modest original cel shading, do not add photo-realistic pores, heavy texture, 3D glossy shine, white sticker border or large shadow. No icons, mortar, leaves, text, menus, background, checkerboard or extra objects. Entire sponge plus all THREE bubbles fully visible, centered with small transparent padding. Faithful clean anti-aliased upscale of the ORIGINAL image2 sponge, not a redesigned rectangular block.
